title: Vapour pressure from the boiling point (Trouton's rule)
summary: Pure liquids, their normal boiling point and vapour pressure, linked by Clausius–Clapeyron; Trouton's rule fixes the entropy of vaporisation, and hydrogen bonding breaks it.

concepts.label: Pure substance
concepts.description: A chemical compound with a structure (SMILES) on Wikidata.

children.label: Normal boiling point
children.description: Temperature at which the vapour pressure is 1 atm (K; the median of the item's statements).

children.label: Vapour pressure
children.description: Pressure of the vapour in equilibrium with the liquid at temperature T (Pa).

children.label: Antoine equation
children.description: log₁₀ P = A − B/(C + T): a three-parameter fit that needs several readings per liquid.

children.label: Hydrogen-bond donor
children.description: O–H (alcohols, acids, glycols) or N–H (amines, amides) groups, read from the SMILES with a pattern.

concepts.label: Clausius–Clapeyron relation
concepts.description: d ln P/d(1/T) = −ΔH_vap/R; with ΔH constant, ln(P/P0) = −(ΔS/R)(Tb/T − 1).

facts.text: Clapeyron stated the relation in 1834; Clausius derived it from thermodynamics in 1850.

children.label: Entropy of vaporisation
children.description: ΔS_vap = ΔH_vap/Tb; here the value one reading implies, R ln(P0/P)/(Tb/T − 1), J/(mol·K).

children.label: Trouton's rule
children.description: ΔS_vap ≈ 10.5 R ≈ 85–88 J/(mol·K) at the normal boiling point for most non-associated liquids.

facts.text: Frederick Trouton reported the near-constant ratio of latent heat to boiling temperature in 1884.

children.label: Heat of vaporisation varies with temperature
children.description: ΔH_vap grows below Tb (Watson's correlation); why room-temperature readings imply about 11.9 R rather than 10.5 R.

concepts.label: Distillation design
concepts.description: Separating liquids by volatility: relative volatility α = P₁/P₂ sets how many stages a column needs.

children.label: Azeotrope
children.description: A mixture that boils without changing composition, common when H-bond donors meet non-donors.

concepts.label: Data provenance
concepts.description: Wikidata statements with their units and qualifiers, mostly from NIOSH and ICSC safety data; rounded and sometimes wrong.

children.label: PubChem experimental properties
children.description: PubChem's annotated vapour pressures and boiling points, to check the suspect readings.
